$comment: Upstream @lenne.tech/nest-server DEVDEPENDENCIES that must land in a vendored project's `dependencies`. Vendoring copies upstream `dependencies` verbatim and does not read `peerDependencies` at all, so a package the framework imports at runtime while keeping it in devDependencies would never reach the production runtime. Entries here are matched against upstream `devDependencies` only — see `isVendorRuntimeDep`, consulted in the `upstreamDevDeps` loop in `extensions/server.ts` — and promoted into `dependencies`, preferring the upstream peer RANGE over the exact devDep pin where one exists, so a generated project still receives patch-level security fixes. A package that appears ONLY in upstream `peerDependencies` cannot be promoted by this list: listing it here is a silent no-op. Two live cases: `find-file-up` (imported by the config loader, devDependency only), and the better-auth trio (declared as peerDependencies AND mirrored into devDependencies upstream; the mirror is what makes the promotion fire, so this list is the fallback if the starter ever stops declaring them itself).
